title.narrative: Apoyo a Poblaciones Vulnerables Afectadas por Coronavirus II
Support for Vulnerable Populations Affected by Coronavirus II

description.narrative: El objetivo de desarrollo general de este proyecto es contribuir a asegurar niveles mnimos de calidad de vida de las personas vulnerables frente a la crisis causada por el COVID-19. El objetivo espcfico es apoyar niveles mnimos de ingreso de personas afectadas por el coronavirus, en el periodo inmediato y durante la recuperacin .

The general development objective of this project is to help ensure minimum levels of quality of life for vulnerable people in the face of the crisis caused by COVID-19 in Bolivia. The specific objective is to support minimum income levels of people affected by the coronavirus, in the immediate period and during recovery.
